why: a siege set breaks into a rampart-lined room held by one tower and a repairer and loses no body: Exchange.breachPlan picks the barrier on the cheapest way to the spawn, two dismantlers break it while two MOVE:HEAL medics seated beside the struck one pool heal. Seeds 1-5 all measured 836 ticks from open to breach (705 casting, 26 walking to the room, 105 under fire) and 8,700 cast; the tick bound adds 34 (about a third of the time under fire). The cast is Exchange's price of the bank, the same on every seed, so its bound has no slack
